source: Kept at 1.0 for the order rule (2026-11-18): the graded episode is the first entry of a random order of the fixed hidden set's 18 entries (tests/online.json) whose unit no lab trial used; the oracle uses no trial, so it plays the first entry (hidden-set entry 5, unit u3). The fixed hidden set holds only entries on which the privileged reference scored 1.0 (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json), and main's anchor is 1.0 over 90 episodes. Under the first conversion's single drawn episode (entry 3, unit u0) the oracle measured 1.0 in validate-9d0a3c5d, validate-658a230c and validate-82c35cd9 (engine bfb7505, Docker, 2026-11-18); the order rule is confirmed by one ale validate of its commit.
